c1.inference_role: prespecified secondary analysis; unadjusted two-sided 95% Student-t interval

decision_withdrawals.routing: the endpoint's support rule was impossible and its schema-v1 interval treated correlated rows as independent

reasons.issue: schema v1 averaged products after standardising each nine-point vector with Bessel-corrected sample standard deviations; apart from its epsilon, that estimator equals (n-1)/n times conventional Pearson r
schema v1 used two-sided 99% Student-t critical values while labelling the intervals as the protocol-required Bonferroni 98.333...% intervals

reasons.corrected_handling: withdraw inferential support; retain the historical naive interval by name and add a topology-clustered descriptive interval over 14 within-topology means
reasons.issue: schema v1 treated two fits from each of 14 evaluation topologies as 28 independent observations, and the endpoint could never satisfy its support rule because every routed / per-trial-minimum ratio is at least one

correction.scope: C1 Pearson correlations, primary Bonferroni-adjusted intervals, and withdrawal of the pseudoreplicated H5 interval; fits and raw endpoint observations are unchanged
unaffected_numeric_fields: routing.trials raw defect and error values

design.exchangeability_assumption: eligible seed-level joint replicates are exchangeable for the Student-t interval; the design does not separate topology heterogeneity from data/noise-realisation heterogeneity
design.fit_scope: one independently trained free matrix W per topology

free_parameters.definition: num_edges * num_faces for each independently fitted W

design.multiplicity: Bonferroni across the three primary contrasts

exact.structural_side_information: B1 determines the target cycle subspace ker(B1); the penalty does not directly use B2 or response labels, but the committed deterministic generator algorithm can recover its noncanonical B2 basis from the graph

rtd.formula: MSE(normalized pairwise distances of X @ W.T, normalized pairwise distances of X)
rtd.target_alignment: the generated truth discards cut-space directions while this surrogate asks the lower-dimensional output to preserve the full source distance geometry

design.paired_fit_sharing: within a seed, all terms share topology, generated train/test predictors, noisy training labels, noiseless held-out targets, and zero initialisation
design.primary_estimand: mean paired log10 held-out-MSE ratio over eligible generator seeds
design.primary_inference_unit: one eligible generator seed, jointly determining topology, training predictors and noise, and noiseless held-out predictors

scarce_probe_geometry.interpretation: reference geometry of the penalty's zero set only; the executed finite penalty leaves all F*E parameters trainable

design.weight_provenance: selected and frozen after exploratory work; no machine-readable selection criterion was retained

implementation_deviations.consequence: the executed penalty is divided by num_vertices * num_faces; because topology dimensions vary, weight 3.0 has a topology-dependent scale relative to the frozen notation

routing.endpoint: log10(routed / per-trial minimum of cell and graph errors) on the evaluation split
routing.protocol_design_note: The routed numerator is one of the two errors in the per-trial denominator, so every endpoint value is nonnegative and the frozen upper-bound-below-zero support rule is impossible. Schema v1 also treated two correlated fits per topology as independent.
